# Cobblemon：野生戰利品
一款 Cobblemon 模組，讓寶可夢有機率在其所在位置隨機掉落其戰利品表中的物品。與類似模組不同，它同樣適用於野生寶可夢和隊列寶可夢（只要它們從精靈球中被放出即可）！

新增了一個儲存方塊「寶可籃」（Pokébasket），可在可設定（預設為 12）格半徑內自動收集被動型寶可夢掉落的物品。可使用任意顏色、共 4 顆 Apricorn 果實與 3 根木棍製作。

![Pokébasket 的合成配方。](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca74e8c2b08836f2beb9584a95062c33b368d16e.png)

## 致謝
- 基於 [Cobblemon Pasture Loot](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-pasture-loot)。
- 使用 Farmer's Delight 的籃子模型。

## 依賴項目
- [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)
- [Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api)

## 設定檔
您可以編輯位於 `config/CobblemonWildLoot.json` 的設定檔來更改各項設定。
- `tick_per_minute`：每分鐘的刻數。除非您將遊戲的刻率更改為非預設值 `20`，否則請保持 1200。
- `drop_chance_per_minute`：每隻寶可夢每分鐘掉落物品的預設機率為 5%。
- `pokebasket_block_radius`：寶可籃自動收集附近寶可夢掉落物品的方塊距離。
- `item_blacklist`：寶可夢不應掉落之物品的清單。
```json
{
  "tick_per_minute": 1200,
  "drop_chance_per_minute": 0.05,
  "pokebasket_block_radius": 12,
  "item_blacklist": [
    "minecraft:porkchop",
    "minecraft:beef",
    "minecraft:chicken",
    "minecraft:mutton",
    "minecraft:rabbit",
    "minecraft:fish",
    "minecraft:cooked_porkchop",
    "minecraft:cooked_beef",
    "minecraft:cooked_chicken",
    "minecraft:cooked_mutton",
    "minecraft:cooked_rabbit",
    "minecraft:cooked_fish",
    "minecraft:leather",
    "minecraft:bone",
    "minecraft:spider_eye",
    "minecraft:rotten_flesh",
    "minecraft:rabbit_hide",
    "minecraft:rabbit_foot",
    "minecraft:cod",
    "minecraft:pufferfish",
    "minecraft:bone_block",
    "minecraft:bone_meal",
    "cobblemon:sharp_beak",
    "minecraft:honey_bottle",
    "minecraft:salmon",
    "minecraft:white_wool"
  ]
}
```
